instructions: Use as copyable reusable text; dynamically supply record/campaign references only when verified. Never embed private tokens or current one-off command IDs.

templates.title: Continue a campaign in a new chat
templates.body: Act as DM for my established solo campaign. Read the current authoritative Astravar checkpoint and player-known records through the connected authorized integration when available, plus relevant campaign library/Notion source files and the latest accepted DM rules. Compare sources by revision and explicit player corrections. Identify the last resolved event, unresolved decision or dice roll, active resources and companions, then continue exactly there. Never invent actions, rolls, HP, currency, loot, hidden information, or a new starting scene. If Astravar is unavailable or sources disagree, report that and ask only for the missing verified checkpoint.

templates.title: Continue Android development in a new Work/Codex chat
templates.body: Resume existing Astravar Android development; do not create a new project. Inspect Brenmack15/Astravar-Overlay, its current development branches and active draft PRs, actual remote heads, latest build and Actions reports, existing project documentation and persisted handoffs. Recover unfinished working files, patches or Git bundles before touching code; reconcile newer commits without discarding work. Preserve accepted mechanics, native Kotlin/Compose, Room migrations, artwork, application identity and signing. Report completed, tested, pending, blocked and unverified work with exact next actions. Do not force-push, merge, rotate keys, claim unrun tests passed, or touch real campaign records without explicit authority.

templates.title: Reconcile Notion and Astravar records
templates.body: Read the authoritative Astravar campaign checkpoint and relevant Notion player-known records through available authorized tools. Do a read-only comparison by stable external IDs, revisions, event receipts and provenance. List records missing on either side, conflicts, stale revisions, and unresolved game facts. Do not infer that Unknown means zero; do not import, merge or modify either side until I approve a precise reconciliation plan.

templates.title: Review a party member level-up
templates.body: For the party member I identify, read their current approved character/companion sheet, inventory, accepted homebrew, latest campaign checkpoint and past level changes. Separate level-derived formulas from granted upgrades and equipment bonuses. Propose an exact before/after diff, required rolls/choices, and source citations. Do not invent HP rolls, spells, features or upgrade choices. Only after player and DM confirmation, submit a version-checked update through the authorized Astravar integration and verify its committed receipt; if write access is unavailable provide a review-only plan.

templates.title: Update inventory, equipment and currency
templates.body: Record only the player-confirmed and DM-resolved inventory, equipment or currency event I identify. Read current party equipment and capabilities, then identify existing items, owners, containers and wallets by stable IDs, not names alone. A give/take/equip/install/store transfer moves the same item without duplication; account for acquired or expended quantities and keep unknown quantities unknown. For currency, verify each denomination and opening balance; unknown does not mean zero, and no exchange rate or spending is invented. Check equipment-conditioned bonuses without counting them twice. Validate provenance and expected revisions, preview the exact before/after changes, then use an authorized atomic command for related item and wallet changes with one idempotent command ID. Verify the original receipt and independent readback. Do not consume proposed crafting materials or commit unresolved events. If write access or an authoritative value is missing, provide a review-only proposal.

templates.title: Save session handoff
templates.body: Produce a player-safe campaign checkpoint from the latest resolved gameplay and connected Astravar/Notion sources, including scene, location and time when verified, current resources, companions, quests, inventory changes, latest committed event, pending dice/decisions and rules versions. Preserve explicit unknowns. If authorized, version-check and store the checkpoint in Astravar, then read it back; otherwise provide a copyable checkpoint and do not claim it was saved.

templates.title: Recover the latest authoritative checkpoint
templates.action: Find and verify the current record before continuing
templates.body: Perform a read-only recovery of the latest authoritative campaign checkpoint. Retrieve actual accessible Astravar records, the established private Notion ledger and persisted checkpoint sources through authorized tools; do not select authority by timestamp alone. Compare stable IDs, revisions, source priority and later player-approved corrections. Report the checkpoint ID and source references, last confirmed action, unresolved decision or roll, current resources and verified party sheets, equipment and capabilities. Preserve unknowns and conflicting values. Do not continue the scene, reset resources, infer missing facts, import records or declare a new source of truth. Never claim to have read inaccessible chats or files. If the current checkpoint cannot be verified, identify the exact missing access or source.

templates.title: Record inventions and completed crafting
templates.action: Keep ideas, research and confirmed construction separate
templates.body: Read the existing invention, accepted recipe version and linked item/research records. Separate proposed ideas and hypotheses from confirmed findings and completed crafting. For a DM-resolved and player-confirmed completion, preview the exact input and output item IDs, known material quantities, retained tools, currency changes, installation or owner, accepted rolls and in-world time, with provenance and expected revisions. Preserve installed components as the same traceable items and prevent duplicate outputs. Do not invent mechanics, consume materials, spend unknown currency, advance time or mark construction complete without the accepted ruling. When an authorized tool is available, commit all related changes atomically with a stable idempotent command ID, recover its original receipt and independently read back the result; otherwise retain a review-only proposal.

templates.title: Recover after conversation context is exhausted
templates.body: Recover continuity after conversation context is exhausted. Determine the campaign or development task from my current request, then retrieve actual accessible checkpoints, accepted rules, project documentation and persisted handoffs before continuing. For campaign play, recover the latest authoritative checkpoint, last resolved event, unresolved rolls or decisions and current sourced records. For development, inspect GitHub branches and active PRs, unfinished work, the latest build, tests and handoff artifacts. Inspect available backup schema/version, source identity, image/event integrity and pending receipts with a read-only restore preview where relevant. Distinguish verified facts, missing access, conflicts and proposals, then state the exact next safe action. Never claim access to earlier inaccessible chats or reconstruct facts by guessing. Do not uninstall apps, overwrite records, restore automatically or declare an untested backup valid. Ask only for a specific missing reference if it is essential to continue.

templates.title: Check synchronization, revisions and conflicts
templates.action: Verify receipts, pending work and authority
templates.body: Perform a read-only synchronization audit through available authorized tools. Check campaign and device scope, local pending outbox commands, expected and remote revisions, conflicts, original immutable receipts, cursor gaps, idempotent retries, credential expiry and revocation. Verify whether ChatGPT and native Astravar actually use the same authoritative store; reaching separate endpoints does not prove synchronization. Distinguish saved locally, pending, conflict and independently verified remote saves. Keep the anonymous public Worker fictional-only and preserve the existing private bridge. Report unavailable access and untested native-client behavior honestly. For source-of-truth readiness also check typed records, import/export fidelity, player-known information boundaries, checkpoint recovery and tested secure backups. Propose reconciliation without silently rebasing or replaying a changed command. Real migration or canonical cutover still requires separate explicit approval.

templates.title: Validate a new signed APK
templates.body: Inspect current Astravar repository head, build logs and test reports. Confirm expected permanent applicationId com.yazsras.astravar, exact owner signing certificate, monotonic version code, approved launcher artwork, Room schema migrations, and core/element/party regressions. Build and verify an APK in an authorized secure environment without exposing signing secrets. Test update and data retention on a disposable emulator. Do not merge a draft PR or install over my live phone without authorization.
